meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: WordPress.com: site action bar, follow bubble, subscribe forms and app banner, plus post image controls (phone UA, one blog checked)
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13 on one WordPress.com-hosted blog, wordpress.com/blog (the WordPress.com news blog), with an iPhone UA (390x844), logged out, headless Chrome; counts were taken on the saved rendered DOM. The desktop UA was stopped by an interstitial bot check (a Checking your browser page), so the desktop layout and other blogs were not captured, and there is only a phone real fixture.

LIVE counts: `#actionbar` 1 (a region labelled Site actions with the Follow button), `#follow-bubble` 1, `.wp-block-jetpack-subscriptions__container` 1, `.x-menu-mobile-app-banner` 1 (the app banner in the menu; 10 elements share the `mobile-app-banner` name), `article img` 19.

The markup comes from WordPress.com and Jetpack features, so it appears on most WordPress.com blogs, but each blog uses its own theme: the `article img` rule depends on the theme using `article` elements, and ads (WordAds), cookie banners, comments and related-posts blocks were not seen on this blog and are not targeted. The original generic rules matched nothing here and are kept. NOT verified: any other `*.wordpress.com` blog, the wordpress.com marketing home, logged-in state.
